summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its periodic report on its share buyback program, executing the third tranche of a multi-year, approximately €3.5 billion repurchase program announced at the 2025 Capital Markets Day. Between October 5 and 9, 2026, Ferrari repurchased 43,000 common shares on Euronext Milan at an average €344.0791 per share, totaling €14.80 million excluding fees. Cumulative third-tranche purchases reached €89.53 million for 253,299 EXM shares and $31.50 million for 77,824 NYSE shares. Treasury holdings equal 1.08% of common shares, or 0.82% of total capital including special voting shares.
